fact: Decree 2.24.921 on cloud service providers requires level-2 providers handling sensitive data to store it physically on Moroccan soil, with a 24-month transition (art. 18) and a conditional exception where no qualified provider exists (art. 17).
title: Hébergement local ou cloud international : lecture du décret n°2.24.921 sur les prestataires de services cloud au Maroc
